pages.title: Missed Me
pages.text: Alternate evasion and weapon guarding while accounting for armor weight and stamina.

pages.title: Getting started
pages.text: Learn and equip the skills. Dodge commonly uses Left Alt and guard uses the item-use control; check bindings. Armor weight affects stamina. Parrying and Impact Guard have their own weapon requirements.

pages.title: Related possibilities
pages.text: Roll and Step provide directional dodges; Guard needs a compatible weapon. Parrying changes timing and Impact Guard changes defense behavior.
